rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Standards and Procedures for Production Adjustment or Shipment Control, etc.) ① Producer organizations pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the “Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)shall be any of the organizations falling under any of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Standards and Procedures for Production Adjustment or Shipment Control, etc.) ① Producer organizations pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the “Act on the Vertical Integration of Livestock Business” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be any of the organizations falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. A nationwide organization that is a non-profit corporation established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act and has livestock farmers as its members, in whole or in part.
rows.text_en: 1. A nationwide organization that is a non-profit corporation established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act and has livestock farmers as its members, in whole or in part.

rows.source_ko: 2. The National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives pursuant to Article 121 of the Agricultural Cooperatives Act or the Nonghyup Economic Holding Company pursuant to Article 161-2 of the same Act
rows.text_en: 2. The National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives pursuant to Article 121 of the Agricultural Cooperatives Act or the Nonghyup Economic Holding Company pursuant to Article 161-2 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 3. Other organizations equivalent to those in Subparagraph 1 or 2, as designated and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
rows.text_en: 3. Other organizations equivalent to those in Subparagraph 1 or 2, as designated and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: ② Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may , upon request by a livestock vertical integration business operator or producer organization, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “producers, etc.” in this Article), determine the matters in each of the following subparagraphs and have the producers, etc. carry out production adjustment or shipment control of the relevant livestock or livestock products (hereinafter referred to as “production adjustment, etc.” in this Article).
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may , upon request by a livestock vertical integration business operator or producer organization, etc. (hereinafter referred to as “producers, etc.” in this Article), determine the matters in each of the following subparagraphs and have the producers, etc. carry out production adjustment or shipment control of the relevant livestock or livestock products (hereinafter referred to as “production adjustment, etc.” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: 1. Target livestock or livestock products
rows.text_en: 1. Target livestock or livestock products

rows.source_ko: 2. Reasons for production adjustment, etc. (including data on the supply and demand volume, price, and income analysis of producers, etc. of the relevant livestock or livestock products)
rows.text_en: 2. Reasons for production adjustment, etc. (including data on the supply and demand volume, price, and income analysis of producers, etc. of the relevant livestock or livestock products)

rows.source_ko: 3. Period and region for production adjustments, etc.
rows.text_en: 3. Period and region for production adjustments, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. The name of the company or legal entity (trade name) of the subject producer, etc., the names and addresses of the representative and officers, and the location of the principal place of business
rows.text_en: 4. The name of the company or legal entity (trade name) of the subject producer, etc., the names and addresses of the representative and officers, and the location of the principal place of business

rows.source_ko: 5. Details of production adjustments, etc. and business details of the subject
rows.text_en: 5. Details of production adjustments, etc. and business details of the subject

rows.source_ko: 6. Post-management and other matters determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
rows.text_en: 6. Post-management and other matters determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: ③ Upon receiving a request pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall consult with the Fair Trade Commission and notify the producers, etc. of the results within 10 days. In this case, Saturdays, public holidays, the period of consultation with the Fair Trade Commission, the period for supplementing the contents of the application, and the period during which notification cannot be made due to natural disasters, etc., shall not be included in the processing period.

rows.source_ko: ④ The standards for making production adjustments, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs in consideration of the matters in each of the following subparagraphs, and shall be publicly announced on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
rows.text_en: ④ The standards for making production adjustments, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs in consideration of the matters in each of the following subparagraphs, and shall be publicly announced on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.text_en: Article 13 (Contract Farmer Damage Compensation Insurance Contract, etc.) Any contract falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 7-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Damage Compensation Insurance Contract, etc.”) must meet all of the following requirements:

rows.source_ko: 1. 계열화사업자의 파산, 일방적 사업 중단, 농가지급금 지급의 지연ㆍ불이행 등으로 인하여 발생한 계약농가의 손해를 배상하는 내용일 것
rows.text_en: 1. It shall contain provisions to compensate for damages incurred by contract farmers due to the bankruptcy of the integrated business operator, unilateral suspension of business, or delay or non-fulfillment of farm payments.

rows.source_ko: 2. 피보험자ㆍ채권자 또는 수익자는 해당 계열화사업자와 계약을 체결한 계약농가 또는 계약농가가 지정한 자로 할 것
rows.text_en: 2. The insured, creditor, or beneficiary shall be the contract farm that has entered into a contract with the relevant integrated business operator or a person designated by the contract farm.

rows.source_ko: 3. 계약금액은 계약농가가 가축을 사육하여 1회 지급받는 농가지급금 이상으로 할 것
rows.text_en: 3. The contract amount shall be equal to or greater than the one-time farm payment received by the contracting farmer for raising livestock.

rows.source_ko: 4. 정당한 사유 없이 계약농가의 의사표시 방법을 제한하거나 계약농가에게 부당하게 입증책임을 지우지 않을 것
rows.text_en: 4. Do not restrict the method of expressing intent of contract farmers without justifiable grounds, nor unfairly impose the burden of proof on contract farmers.

rows.source_ko: 5. 정당한 사유 없이 손해배상의 범위나 보험자ㆍ보증인 또는 계열화사업자의 책임을 한정하지 않을 것
rows.text_en: 5. The scope of damages or the liability of the insurer, guarantor, or affiliated business operator shall not be limited without justifiable cause.

rows.source_ko: 6. 계약기간은 6개월 이상으로 하고, 정당한 사유 없이 계약을 해지할 수 없도록 하여 계약농가에게 불이익을 주지 않을 것
rows.text_en: 6. The contract period shall be at least six months, and the contract shall not be terminated without justifiable cause to ensure that no disadvantage is imposed on the contracting farmer.

rows.source_ko: 7. 보험금ㆍ보증금은 해당 계열화사업자와 계약을 체결한 계약농가 또는 계약농가가 지정한 자가 직접 수령할 수 있도록 할 것
rows.text_en: 7. Insurance proceeds and guarantee funds shall be received directly by the contract farmer who has entered into a contract with the relevant integrated business operator, or by a person designated by the contract farmer.

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 계약농가에게 예상하기 어려운 위험이나 손해를 줄 염려가 있거나 부당하게 불리한 약정을 두지 않을 것
rows.text_en: 8. Furthermore, shall not include any agreements that pose a risk of causing unforeseeable risks or losses to the contracting farmer, or are unfairly disadvantageous.

rows.source_ko: 제14조(준수사항) ① 법 제9조제1항에 따른 금지행위의 유형 및 기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Compliance Requirements) ①The types and standards of prohibited acts pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제9조제4항제6호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 행위”란 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The “acts prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 9, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 6 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 3 .

rows.source_ko: 제15조(정보공개서의 등록) ① 계열화사업자는 법 제9조의2제1항에 따라 정보공개서를 등록하려는 경우에는 별지 제9호서식의 정보공개서 등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Registration of Information Disclosure Statement) ① Ifan affiliated business operator intends to register an information disclosure statement pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall submit to the Mayor or Provincial Governor an application for registration of an information disclosure statement in the form of Annex 9 , attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정보공개서 및 「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」 제2조제1항제1호에 따른 정보통신망(이하 “정보통신망”이라 한다)을 이용한 전자 파일
rows.text_en: 1. Information disclosure statement and electronic files using an information and communications network pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “information and communications network”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 최근 3개 사업연도의 재무제표와 그 부속명세서(설립 중인 회사ㆍ법인은 제외하며, 설립일부터 3개 사업연도가 지나지 않은 경우에는 설립일부터 최근 사업연도까지의 재무제표와 그 부속명세서를 제출해야 하고, 계열화사업자가 재무제표를 작성하지 않는 경우에는 최근 3개 사업연도의 매출액을 확인할 수 있는 서류를 제출해야 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Financial statements and supporting schedules for the most recent three fiscal years (excluding companies or corporations in the process of establishment; if three fiscal years have not passed since the date of establishment, financial statements and supporting schedules from the date of establishment to the most recent fiscal year must be submitted, and if an affiliated business operator does not prepare financial statements, documents verifying sales revenue for the most recent three fiscal years must be submitted).

rows.source_ko: 3. 최근 3개 사업연도말 기준 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도 또는 특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)별 계약농가의 수를 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents verifying the number of contract farm households by Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province”) as of the end of the last three fiscal years

rows.source_ko: 4. 계열화사업 계약서 사본
rows.text_en: 4. Copy of Affiliate Business Agreement

rows.source_ko: 5. 직전 사업연도말 기준 재직 중인 임직원의 수를 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Documents verifying the number of employees and executives employed as of the end of the immediately preceding fiscal year

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 정보공개서의 내용과 관련 있는 서류로서 시ㆍ도지사가 정한 서류
rows.text_en: 6. Other documents related to the contents of the information disclosure statement as determined by the Mayor or Provincial Governor

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받은 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류(제3호의 경우에는 사본을 말한다)를 제출하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor or Provincial Governor shall verify the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent, they shall be required to submit such documents (in the case of subparagraph 3, a copy thereof).

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인 등기사항증명서
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 법인의 설립 등기 전에 등록을 신청하는 경우에는 법인을 설립하려는 발기인의 주민등록표 초본
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where registration is applied for prior to the incorporation registration of the relevant corporation, a copy of the resident registration record of the promoters intending to establish the corporation

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업자등록증
rows.text_en: 3. Business Registration Certificate

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사는 제2항에 따라 제출된 서류를 검토한 후 등록요건에 적합하다고 인정하는 때에는 등록신청일부터 30일(법 제5조의6제1항에 따라 등록이 취소된 계열화사업자가 다시 등록을 신청한 경우에는 2개월) 이내에 별지 제10호서식의 정보공개서 등록증명서를 해당 계열화사업자에게 발급하고, 정보시스템에 등록에 관한 사항을 입력해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Mayor or Provincial Governor reviews the documents submitted pursuant to Paragraph 2 and recognizes that they meet the registration requirements, he or she shall issue a Certificate of Registration of Information Disclosure in Form No. 10 to the relevant affiliated business operator within 30 days from the date of application for registration ( 2 months in the case where an affiliated business operator whose registration was canceled pursuant to Article 5-6 Paragraph 1 of the Act applies for registration again) , and enter the details regarding registration into the information system.

rows.source_ko: ④ 계열화사업자는 정보시스템을 통해 제1항에 따른 정보공개서의 등록신청과 법 제9조의2제3항에 따른 변경등록신청 및 변경신고를 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ An affiliated business operator may apply for registration of the information disclosure statement pursuant to Paragraph 1 and apply for registration of change and report of change pursuant to Paragraph 3 of Article 9-2 of the Act through the information system.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(정보공개서의 기재사항) ① 법 제9조의2제2항에 따라 정보공개서에는 별표 4에 따른 정보공개서의 기재사항(이하 “정보공개사항”이라 한다)을 수록해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Contents of Information Disclosure Statement) ① Pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the information disclosure statement shall include the contents of the information disclosure statement as set forth in Annex 4 (hereinafter referred to as “information disclosure matters”).

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 계약농가의 알권리 보장을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 정보공개사항에 대하여 가축의 종류별로 세부적인 기재사항을 정하여 고시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs deems it necessary to guarantee the right to know of contract farmers, he/she may prescribe and announce detailed information to be disclosed for each type of livestock.

rows.source_ko: 제17조(정보공개서의 변경등록신청 및 변경신고) ① 법 제9조의2제3항 본문에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 중요한 사항”이란 별표 5에 따른 변경등록사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Application for Registration of Change and Notification of Change of Information Disclosure Statement) ① In the main text of Article 9-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “important matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”refers to matters for registration of change pursuant to Annex 5 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제9조의2제3항 본문에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 기한”이란 별표 5에 따른 변경등록 기한을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In the main text of Article 9-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “the deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the deadline for change registration pursuant to Annex 5 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제9조의2제3항 단서에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 경미한 사항”이란 별표 5에 따른 변경신고사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In the proviso to Article 9-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , “minor matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to matters for which a change report is filed pursuant to Annex 5 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 계열화사업자는 별표 5에 따른 변경등록사항을 변경하려는 경우에는 별지 제11호서식의 정보공개서 변경등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If an affiliated business operator intends to change the matters for change registration pursuant to Annex 5 , they must submit an application for change registration of the information disclosure statement in Form No. 11 to the Mayor or Provincial Governor, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 변경된 정보공개서 및 정보통신망을 이용한 전자 파일
rows.text_en: 1. Amended Information Disclosure Statement and Electronic Files via Information and Communications Network

rows.source_ko: 2. 변경 내용을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the changes

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제10호서식의 정보공개서 등록증명서(등록증명서의 기재사항을 변경하려는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Certificate of Registration of Information Disclosure Statement in Form No. 10 (only applicable if you intend to change the details on the Certificate of Registration)

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 계열화사업자는 별표 5에 따른 변경신고사항을 변경하려는 경우에는 별지 제11호서식의 정보공개서 변경신고서에 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ If an affiliated business operator intends to change the matters reported for change pursuant to Annex 5 , they must submit a report on changes to the information disclosure statement in Form No. 11 to the mayor or provincial governor, attaching documents proving the details of the change.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제4항에 따른 신청서 또는 제5항에 따른 신고서를 제출받은 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 법인 등기사항증명서와 사업자등록증을 확인(변경등록에 필요한 경우만 해당한다)해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이나 신고인이 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류(사업자등록증의 경우에는 사본을 말한다)를 제출하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Upon receiving an application form pursuant to Paragraph 4 or a report pursuant to Paragraph 5, the Mayor or Provincial Governor shall verify the certificate of corporate registration and the business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act (only applicable if necessary for a change of registration). However, if the applicant or the reporter does not consent, they shall be required to submit the documents (in the case of a business registration certificate, a copy).

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 시ㆍ도지사는 제4항 또는 제5항에 따른 변경등록신청 또는 변경신고일부터 20일 이내에 변경된 정보의 확인을 거쳐 변경사항을 기재한 정보공개서 등록증명서를 해당 계열화사업자에게 발급하고, 정보시스템에 변경등록신청 또는 변경신고에 관한 사항을 입력해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The mayor or provincial governor shall, within 20 days from the date of the application for change registration or the report of change pursuant to Paragraph 4 or 5, verify the changed information and issue a certificate of registration of the information disclosure statement containing the changes to the relevant affiliated business operator, and enter the details regarding the application for change registration or the report of change into the information system.

rows.source_ko: 제18조(정보공개서의 공개) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 정보공개서를 공개하려는 경우에는 법 제9조의2제5항에 따라 다음 각 호의 사항을 적은 서면으로 공개일 10일 전까지 해당 계열화사업자에게 그 사실을 미리 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Disclosure of Information Disclosure Statement) ① In cases where the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs intends to disclose an information disclosure statement, he/ she shall notify the relevant integrated business operator of such fact in writing, specifying the matters of each of the following subparagraphs, no later than 10 days prior to the date of disclosure, in accordance with Article 9-2, Paragraph 5 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 공개 목적과 공개 기간
rows.text_en: 1. Purpose of Disclosure and Disclosure Period

rows.source_ko: 2. 공개 내용
rows.text_en: 2. Contents disclosed

rows.source_ko: 3. 공개 방법
rows.text_en: 3. Method of disclosure

rows.source_ko: 4. 계열화사업자의 정정 또는 비공개 요구 방법
rows.text_en: 4. Method for Affiliated Business Operators to Request Correction or Non-disclosure

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 통지를 받은 계열화사업자는 공개하는 내용 중 사실과 다른 내용이 있거나 법 제9조의2제4항 단서에 해당하는 내용이 있으면 통지를 받은 날부터 7일 이내에 그 사실을 증명하는 서류를 첨부한 서면으로 농림축산식품부장관에게 그 내용의 정정 또는 비공개를 요구할 수 있다. 이 경우 농림축산식품부장관은 계열화사업자의 요구가 정당하다고 인정되면 정보공개서의 공개 내용을 정정하거나 공개하지 않아야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② An integrated business operator who has received a notice pursuant to Paragraph 1 may request the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to correct or withhold such contents by submitting a written document attached with supporting documents proving the facts within 7 days from the date of receiving the notice, if there are contents among the disclosed contents that differ from the facts or contents falling under the proviso to Paragraph 4 of Article 9-2 of the Act. In this case, if the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs deems the request of the integrated business operator to be justified, he/she shall correct or not disclose the contents of the information disclosure statement.

rows.source_ko: 제19조(정보공개서 등록의 취소) 농림축산식품부장관 및 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제9조의4제1항제1호 또는 제2호에 해당하는 사유로 정보공개서의 등록을 취소한 경우에는 취소한 날부터 7일 이내에 해당 계열화사업자에게 서면으로 그 사실과 취소 사유를 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Cancellation of Registration of Information Disclosure Statement) If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Mayor or Provincial Governor cancel the registration of an information disclosure statement due to grounds falling under Article 9-4, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 1 or 2 of the Act, they shall notify the relevant affiliated business operator of the fact and the grounds for cancellation in writing within 7 days from the date of cancellation.

rows.source_ko: 제20조(정보공개서의 제공) ① 계열화사업자는 법 제9조의5제1항에 따라 계약체결을 희망하는 농가(이하 “계약희망농가”라 한다)에게 정보공개서를 제공하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 방법에 따라야 한다. 다만, 제3호 및 제4호의 경우에는 문서 형태로 인쇄가 가능하도록 하는 조치를 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Provision of Information Disclosure Statements) ① When an integrated business operator provides information disclosure statements to farmers who wish to enter into a contract (hereinafter referred to as “farmers wishing to enter into a contract”) pursuant to Article 9-5 , Paragraph 1 of the Act, it shall comply with any of the methods specified in the following subparagraphs. However, in the case of subparagraphs 3 and 4, measures must be taken to ensure that the information can be printed in document form.

rows.source_ko: 1. 계약희망농가에게 정보공개서를 직접 전달하는 방법
rows.text_en: 1. Method of directly delivering the Information Disclosure Statement to prospective farmers

rows.source_ko: 2. 계약희망농가에게 정보공개서를 제공한 시점을 확인할 수 있는 내용증명우편으로 제공하는 방법
rows.text_en: 2. A method of providing the information disclosure statement to prospective farmers via certified mail that verifies the date of provision.

rows.source_ko: 3. 정보통신망을 이용하여 정보공개서의 내용을 게시한 후 게시한 사실을 계약희망농가에게 알리는 방법
rows.text_en: 3. Method of notifying prospective contract farmers of the fact that the contents of the information disclosure statement have been posted using an information and communication network

rows.source_ko: 4. 계약희망농가의 전자우편 주소로 정보공개서의 내용이 포함된 전자 파일을 보내는 방법
rows.text_en: 4. Method of sending an electronic file containing the contents of the Information Disclosure Statement to the email address of prospective contract farmers

rows.source_ko: ② 계열화사업자는 정보공개서를 제공한 후 계약체결 전에 중요사항이 변경된 경우에는 그 변경된 내용을 제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 방법으로 계약희망농가에게 지체 없이 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If important matters are changed after providing the information disclosure statement but before concluding the contract, the affiliated business operator must notify prospective farmers of such changes without delay by any of the methods specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제21조(정보공개서의 표준양식) 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제9조의5제3항에 따라 정보공개서의 표준양식을 정하여 고시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Standard Form for Information Disclosure Statement) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may prescribe and announce a standard form for an information disclosure statement pursuant to Article 9-5, Paragraph 3 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 제22조(허위ㆍ과장된 정보제공 행위 등의 유형) ① 법 제9조의6제1항제1호에서 “사실과 다르게 정보를 제공하거나 사실을 부풀려 정보를 제공하는 행위 등 농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 허위ㆍ과장의 정보제공행위”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 행위를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Types of Acts of Providing False or Exaggerated Information, etc.) ① The term “acts of providing false or exaggerated information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, such as providing information differently from the facts or providing information by inflating the facts” in Article 9-6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act refers to any of the following acts:

rows.source_ko: 1. 객관적인 근거 없이 계약희망농가의 예상수익상황을 과장하여 제공하거나 사실과 다르게 계열화사업자가 최저수익 등을 보장하는 것처럼 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 1. The act of exaggerating the expected profit situation of prospective farmers without objective grounds, or providing information that falsely implies that the integrated business operator guarantees minimum profits, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 계약희망농가의 농가지급금, 예상수익 등과 관련하여 사실 여부가 확인되지 않은 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 2. The act of providing unverified information regarding farm payments, expected profits, etc., of prospective farmers.

rows.source_ko: 3. 계열화사업자의 사업현황을 부풀리거나 구성되지 않은 농가협의회가 구성된 것처럼 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 3. The act of inflating the business status of an integrated business operator or providing information as if a farmers' council has been established when it has not.

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 규정에 따른 행위에 준하여 사실과 다르게 정보를 제공하거나 사실을 부풀려 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 4. The act of providing information that is contrary to the facts or providing information that exaggerates the facts, in accordance with the acts under Subparagraphs 1 through 3.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제9조의6제1항제2호에서 “계약의 체결ㆍ유지에 중대한 영향을 미치는 사실을 은폐하거나 축소하는 방법으로 정보를 제공하는 행위 등 농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 기만적인 정보제공행위”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 행위를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 9-6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act , “deceptive acts of providing information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, such as providing information by concealing or downplaying facts that have a significant impact on the conclusion or maintenance of a contract” refers to any of the following acts:

rows.source_ko: 1. 중요사항을 적지 않은 정보공개서를 계약희망농가에게 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 1. The act of providing a disclosure statement to prospective farmers that does not include important details.

rows.source_ko: 2. 계열화사업자가 계약희망농가에게 지원하는 금전, 상품 또는 용역 등이 일정 요건이 충족되는 경우에만 지원됨에도 불구하고 해당 요건을 제시하지 않으면서 모든 경우에 지원되는 것처럼 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 2. The act of an integrated business operator providing information to prospective farmers as if funds, goods, or services are provided in all cases without specifying the requirements, even though such support is provided only when certain conditions are met.

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 또는 제2호에 따른 행위에 준하여 계약의 체결ㆍ유지에 중대한 영향을 미치는 사실을 은폐하거나 축소하는 방법으로 정보를 제공하는 행위
rows.text_en: 3. An act of providing information by concealing or downplaying facts that have a significant impact on the conclusion or maintenance of a contract, in a manner equivalent to the acts under Subparagraph 1 or 2.

rows.source_ko: 제23조(예상수익상황에 대한 정보제공 등) 법 제9조의6제3항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 자료”란 다음 각 호에 관한 자료를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Provision of Information on Expected Profit Situation, etc.) In Article 9-6, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the term “data prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to data concerning each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 현재의 수익상황이나 장래의 예상수익상황과 관련된 정보의 산출에 사용된 사실적인 근거와 예측
rows.text_en: 1. Factual grounds and forecasts used to calculate information related to current profit situations or future projected profit situations

rows.source_ko: 2. 현재의 수익상황이나 장래의 예상수익상황과 관련된 정보의 산출근거가 되는 계약농가의 수와 그 비율
rows.text_en: 2. The number of contract farms and their ratio serving as the basis for calculating information related to current or projected future profit situations

rows.source_ko: 3. 최근의 일정기간 동안에 계열화사업자가 제공한 정보에서 표시 또는 설명하는 현재의 수익 또는 장래의 예상수익과 같은 수준의 수익을 올리는 계약농가의 수와 그 비율. 이 경우 최근의 일정기간에 대해서는 시작하는 날짜와 끝나는 날짜를 표시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: 3. The number and percentage of contract farms that generate a level of profit equivalent to the current profit or future projected profit indicated or described in the information provided by the affiliated business operator during a recent certain period. In this case, the start and end dates must be indicated for the recent certain period.

rows.source_ko: 제24조(계열화사업자 평가 및 등급결정의 대상) ① 법 제10조제1항에 따른 계열화사업자의 평가 및 등급결정은 제3조제2호 또는 제3호의 가축에 관해 계열화사업을 등록한 자를 대상으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Subjects of Evaluation and Grade Determination of Vertically Integrated Business Operators) ①The evaluation and grade determination of vertically integrated business operators pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be applied to persons who have registered a vertically integrated business with respect to livestock under Article 3 , Subparagraph 2 or 3 .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 계열화사업자의 평가 및 등급결정은 법 제5조의3제1항에 따라 계열화사업을 등록한 가축의 종류별로 실시한다. 이 경우 계열화사업자가 여러 가축의 종류에 대해 계열화사업을 등록한 때에는 그 가축의 종류별로 각각 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ② The evaluation and grade determination of an integrated business operator pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be carried out for each type of livestock for which an integrated business has been registered pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act . In this case, if an integrated business operator has registered an integrated business for multiple types of livestock, the evaluation shall be carried out for each type of livestock.

rows.source_ko: 제25조(계열화사업자의 평가 기준 등) ① 법 제10조제1항에 따른 계열화사업자의 평가 기준은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Evaluation Criteria, etc. for Affiliated Business Operators) ① The evaluation criteria for affiliated business operators pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 계열화사업자와 계약농가 간의 계약 체결 과정 및 계약의 공정성
rows.text_en: 1. Contract conclusion process and fairness of the contract between vertically integrated business operators and contract farmers

rows.source_ko: 2. 계열화사업자의 법 위반 예방 및 자율 준수 노력의 정도
rows.text_en: 2. The extent of affiliated business operators' efforts to prevent legal violations and ensure voluntary compliance

rows.source_ko: 3. 계열화사업자와 계약농가 간의 상생 협력을 위한 노력의 정도
rows.text_en: 3. The extent of efforts for mutually beneficial cooperation between vertically integrated business operators and contract farmers

rows.source_ko: 4. 계열화사업자의 사업 역량 및 사회 기여도
rows.text_en: 4. Business Capabilities and Social Contribution of Affiliated Business Operators

rows.source_ko: 5. 계약농가의 계열화사업자에 대한 만족도
rows.text_en: 5. Contract Farmers' Satisfaction with Affiliated Business Operators

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관이 계열화사업자의 평가를 위한 기준으로 정하여 고시하는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters determined and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs as standards for the evaluation of vertically integrated business operators.

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 평가목적, 추진방향 및 평가방법 등을 포함한 평가기본계획을 수립하고, 이에 따라 평가해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall establish a basic evaluation plan including the purpose of evaluation, direction of implementation, and evaluation methods, and conduct evaluations in accordance with such plan.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제10조제1항에 따른 계열화사업자에 대한 평가는 서면평가를 원칙으로 한다. 다만, 제1항 각 호에 따른 평가 기준 자료의 진위 및 서면평가 결과의 확인이 필요한 경우에는 법 제10조제3항에 따라 계열화사업자의 사업장 또는 계약농가를 방문하여 조사할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ In principle, the evaluation of an integrated business operator pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be conducted by written evaluation. However, if it is necessary to verify the authenticity of the evaluation criteria data and the results of the written evaluation pursuant to each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 , an investigation may be conducted by visiting the business site of the integrated business operator or the contract farm pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ④ 농림축산식품부장관은 계열화사업자에 대한 평가를 완료한 경우에는 그 결과를 해당 계열화사업자에게 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs has completed the evaluation of an integrated business operator, he/she shall notify the relevant integrated business operator of the results.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제10조제4항에 따라 조사를 하는 사람의 증표는 별지 제12호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The identification card of a person conducting an investigation pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in the form of Annex 12 .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 계열화사업자의 평가에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for the evaluation of integrated business operators shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: 제26조(계열화사업자의 등급결정) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제10조제1항에 따른 계열화사업자에 대한 평가를 완료한 경우에는 그 평가결과에 따라 우수, 양호, 보통, 미흡으로 등급을 결정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Determination of Grade for Vertically Integrated Business Operators) ① When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs has completed the evaluation of a vertically integrated business operator pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall determine the grade as excellent, good, average, or poor based on the evaluation results.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 등급결정에 관한 세부기준은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② Detailed standards for grade determination pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: 제27조(계열화사업자의 등급결정 절차) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 제26조제1항에 따른 등급결정을 2년마다 정기적으로 실시한다. 다만, 농림축산식품부장관이 계열화사업의 수준 향상 등을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 1년마다 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Procedure for Grade Determination of Vertically Integrated Business Operators) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall conduct grade determinations pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 on a regular basis every two years. However, if the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs deems it necessary to improve the level of vertically integrated business, etc., grade determinations may be conducted every year.

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관이 제25조제3항 단서에 따라 방문하여 조사를 하는 경우에는 공정한 평가를 위하여 현장평가단을 구성ㆍ운영해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs conducts an investigation by visiting pursuant to the proviso of Article 25, Paragraph 3, an on-site evaluation team must be formed and operated to ensure a fair evaluation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 농림축산식품부장관은 제2항에 따른 현장평가단의 조사ㆍ평가에 대한 지침을 마련해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall establish guidelines for the investigation and evaluation by the field evaluation team pursuant to Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ④ 농림축산식품부장관은 제26조제1항에 따른 등급결정 결과를 해당 계열화사업자에게 알려야 하고, 정보통신망이나 신문ㆍ방송 등 언론매체 등을 통해 그 결과를 공표할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall notify the relevant integrated business operator of the results of the grade determination pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1, and may publish the results through information and communications networks or media outlets such as newspapers and broadcasting.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 등급결정 절차에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the grade determination procedure shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .

rows.source_ko: 제28조(등급결정 결과의 활용) 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제10조제2항에 따라 등급결정 결과를 다음 각 호에 관한 사항을 위한 자료로 활용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Utilization of Grade Determination Results) Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairsmay utilize grade determination results as data for matters concerning each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 계열화사업자에 대한 지도, 관리 및 육성정책
rows.text_en: 1. Guidance, Management, and Development Policy for Affiliated Business Operators

rows.source_ko: 2. 계열화사업자에 대한 예산의 지원 및 배제
rows.text_en: 2. Budgetary Support and Exclusion of Affiliated Business Operators

rows.source_ko: 3. 「농ㆍ축산ㆍ임ㆍ어업용 기자재 및 석유류에 대한 부가가치세 영세율 및 면세 적용 등에 관한 특례규정」 제2조제5호에 따른 계열화사업자의 가축용 사료에 대한 부가가치세 영(零)의 세율 적용 또는 적용제외
rows.text_en: 3. Application of the zero VAT rate or exclusion from application of VAT on livestock feed by vertically integrated business operators pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the "Special Provisions on the Application of Zero VAT Rates and Exemptions for Equipment and Materials for Agriculture, Livestock , Forestry, and Fisheries and Petroleum Products"

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관이 계열화사업의 수준 향상을 위하여 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the improvement of the standards of vertical integration businesses

rows.source_ko: 제29조(계약사육농가협의회의 설치) ① 계약농가는 법 제14조제1항에 따른 계약사육농가협의회(이하 “농가협의회”라 한다)를 법 제5조의3제1항에 따라 계열화사업을 등록한 계열화사업자 단위로 설치할 수 있다. 이 경우 계열화사업자가 여러 가축의 종류에 대해 계열화사업을 하는 때에는 그 가축의 종류별로 설치할 수 있으며, 지역을 달리하는 사업장이 있는 때에는 그 사업장별로 설치할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Establishment of Contract Farmers' Council) ① Contract farmersmay establish a Contract Farmers' Council (hereinafter referred to as the “Farmers’ Council”) pursuant to Article 14 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , on the unit of a vertically integrated business operator registered pursuant to Article 5-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act . In this case, if a vertically integrated business operator conducts vertically integrated business for several types of livestock, the Council may be established for each type of livestock, and if there are business sites located in different regions, the Council may be established for each business site.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제14조제6항에 따른 가축의 종류별 중앙계약사육농가협의회(이하 “중앙농가협의회”라 한다)는 제1항에 따른 농가협의회의 대표를 회원으로 하여 가축의 종류별로 설치하며, 그 효율적인 운영을 위하여 분과협의회를 둘 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Central Contract Farmers' Council for each type of livestock pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 6 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Central Farmers' Council”) shall be established for each type of livestock with the representatives of the Farmers' Council pursuant to Paragraph 1 as members, and may establish subcommittees for efficient operation.

rows.source_ko: 제30조(분쟁조정의 신청 등) ① 법 제25조제1항에 따라 분쟁조정을 신청하려는 자는 다음 각 호에 관한 사항이 기재된 분쟁조정신청서를 관할 시ㆍ도지사 또는 법 제16조제1항에 따른 축산계열화사업분쟁조정위원회(이하 “조정위원회”라 한다)에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Application for Dispute Mediation, etc.) ①Any person who intends to apply for dispute mediation pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a dispute mediation application containing matters concerning each of the following subparagraphs to the competent mayor or provincial governor or the Livestock Industry Integration Business Dispute Mediation Committee pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Mediation Committee”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 신청인과 피신청인의 성명과 주소(분쟁당사자가 회사ㆍ법인인 경우에는 회사ㆍ법인명, 그 대표자의 성명 및 주 사업장의 소재지를 말한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Names and addresses of the applicant and the respondent (in cases where the parties to the dispute are companies or corporations, the name of the company or corporation, the name of its representative, and the location of its principal place of business)

rows.source_ko: 2. 대리인이 있는 경우에는 그 성명과 주소
rows.text_en: 2. If there is an agent, their name and address

rows.source_ko: 3. 신청의 취지와 그 이유
rows.text_en: 3. Purpose of the application and the reasons therefor

rows.source_ko: ② 분쟁조정신청서에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The application for dispute mediation must be accompanied by the following documents:

rows.source_ko: 1. 분쟁조정 신청의 원인과 그 사실을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. The cause of the application for dispute mediation and documents proving the facts thereof

rows.source_ko: 2. 대리인이 신청하는 경우에는 그 위임장
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of an agent applying, the power of attorney

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 분쟁조정에 필요한 증거서류나 자료
rows.text_en: 3. Other evidentiary documents or materials necessary for dispute mediation

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회는 법 제25조제1항에 따라 분쟁조정의 신청을 받은 경우에는 같은 항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는지 여부를 10일 이내의 기간에 검토해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor or provincial governor or the mediation committee receives an application for dispute mediation pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall review whether it falls under any of the subparagraphs of the same paragraph within a period of 10 days.

rows.source_ko: ④ 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회는 법 제25조제2항에 따라 분쟁조정신청서를 접수한 때에는 신청인에게 분쟁조정신청서 접수증을 발급하고, 피신청인에게는 분쟁조정신청서의 사본을 보내야 한다. 이 경우 「전자정부법」 제2조제7호에 따른 전자문서로 송신할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ When a mayor or provincial governor or the mediation committee receives an application for dispute mediation pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they shall issue a receipt for the application for dispute mediation to the applicant and send a copy of the application for dispute mediation to the respondent. In this case , it may be transmitted as an electronic document pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 7 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회는 법 제25조제1항에 따른 분쟁조정의 신청 또는 같은 조 제3항에 따른 분쟁조정의 회부에 대하여 보완이 필요하다고 인정되는 때에는 상당한 기간을 정하여 보완을 요구할 수 있다. 이 경우 보완에 소요되는 기간은 법 제25조의2제5항제2호의 기간에 산입하지 않는다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When a mayor or provincial governor or the mediation committee deems that supplementation is necessary regarding an application for dispute mediation under Article 25 , Paragraph 1 of the Act or a referral for dispute mediation under Paragraph 3 of the same Act, they may request supplementation by setting a reasonable period. In this case, the period required for supplementation shall not be included in the period under Article 25-2, Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 제31조(대표자의 선정) ① 다수의 계약농가 또는 계열화사업자가 동일한 사안에 대하여 공동으로 분쟁조정을 신청하는 때에는 신청인 중 3명 이내의 대표자를 선정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Selection of Representatives) ① When multiple contract farmers or integrated business operators jointly apply for dispute mediation regarding the same matter, up to three representatives may be selected from among the applicants.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청인이 대표자를 선정하지 않은 때에는 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회의 위원장은 신청인에게 대표자를 선정할 것을 권고할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If the applicant has not selected a representative pursuant to Paragraph 1, the mayor or provincial governor or the chairperson of the mediation committee may recommend that the applicant select a representative.

rows.source_ko: ③ 신청인은 대표자를 선정하거나 변경하는 때에는 그 사실을 지체 없이 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회의 위원장에게 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the applicant selects or changes a representative, they must notify the mayor/governor of the city/province or the chairperson of the mediation committee of such fact without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제32조(출석 요청 등) ① 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회는 법 제25조의2제3항에 따라 분쟁당사자에 대하여 출석을 요청하려는 때에는 시기 및 장소를 정하여 출석 요청일 7일 전까지 분쟁당사자에게 서면으로 통지해야 한다. 다만, 긴급을 요하거나 출석의 통지를 받을 자가 미리 동의하는 경우에는 구두 또는 전화 등으로 통지할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Request for Attendance, etc.) ① When a City/Do Governor or a Mediation Committee intends to request the attendance of a party to a dispute pursuant to Article 25-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act, they shall determine the time and place and notify the party to the dispute in writing at least 7 days prior to the date of the request for attendance. However, if urgency is required or if the person to be notified of attendance consents in advance, notice may be given orally or by telephone, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항의 통지를 받은 분쟁당사자가 출석할 수 없는 부득이한 사유가 있는 경우에는 미리 서면으로 의견을 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If a party to a dispute who has received the notice under Paragraph 1 has unavoidable reasons preventing them from attending, they may submit their opinion in writing in advance.

rows.source_ko: 제33조(소 제기의 통지) 분쟁당사자는 분쟁조정 신청 후 해당 사건에 대하여 소를 제기한 경우에는 지체 없이 이를 시ㆍ도지사 또는 조정위원회에 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Notice of Filing of Lawsuit) If a party to a dispute files a lawsuit regarding the relevant case after applying for dispute mediation, they shall notify the Mayor/Do Governor or the Mediation Committee without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제34조(분쟁조정 등) ① 조정위원회는 법 제25조의2제4항에 따라 분쟁조정 신청을 각하하거나 같은 조 제5항제2호 또는 제4호에 따라 조정절차를 종료한 경우에는 다음 각 호에 관한 사항이 기재된 분쟁조정종료서를 작성하여 그 사본과 관련 서류를 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Dispute Mediation, etc.) ① When the Mediation Committee dismisses an application for dispute mediation pursuant to Article 25-2, Paragraph 4 of the Act, or terminates the mediation procedure pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 2 or 4 of the same Act, it shall prepare a document of termination of dispute mediation containing the matters concerning each of the following subparagraphs and submit a copy thereof and related documents to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 분쟁당사자
rows.text_en: 1. Parties to the Dispute

rows.source_ko: 2. 분쟁의 경위
rows.text_en: 2. Circumstances of the Dispute

rows.source_ko: 3. 조정의 쟁점
rows.text_en: 3. Issues of Mediation

rows.source_ko: 4. 조정신청의 각하 또는 조정절차의 종료 사유
rows.text_en: 4. Grounds for dismissal of application for mediation or termination of mediation proceedings

rows.source_ko: ② 조정위원회는 분쟁조정사항에 대하여 조정이 성립된 경우에는 다음 각 호에 관한 사항이 기재된 조정조서를 작성하여 그 사본과 관련 서류를 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If mediation is concluded regarding a matter of dispute mediation, the Mediation Committee shall prepare a mediation record containing the matters concerning each of the following subparagraphs and submit a copy thereof and related documents to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제1항제1호부터 제3호까지의 내용
rows.text_en: 1. Contents of Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 through 3

rows.source_ko: 2. 조정의 결과
rows.text_en: 2. Results of Adjustment

rows.source_ko: 제35조(조정위원회의 운영) ① 조정위원회의 위원장은 조정위원회의 회의를 소집하고, 그 의장이 된다.
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Operation of the Mediation Committee) ① The Chairperson of the Mediation Committee shall convene meetings of the Mediation Committee and preside over them.

rows.source_ko: ② 조정위원회의 회의는 재적위원 과반수의 출석으로 개의(開議)하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ② A meeting of the Mediation Committee shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: ③ 조정위원회의 위원장이 조정위원회의 회의를 소집하려면 위원에게 회의 개최 7일 전까지 회의의 일시, 장소 및 안건을 서면으로 통지해야 한다. 다만, 긴급을 요하는 경우에는 구두 또는 전화 등으로 통지할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the Chairperson of the Mediation Committee intends to convene a meeting of the Mediation Committee, he/she must notify the members in writing of the date, time, place, and agenda of the meeting at least 7 days prior to the meeting. However, in cases requiring urgency, notice may be given orally or by telephone.

rows.source_ko: ④ 조정위원회의 회의는 공개하지 않는다. 다만, 조정위원회의 위원장이 필요하다고 인정하는 때에는 분쟁당사자, 그 밖의 이해관계인이 방청하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ Meetings of the Mediation Committee shall not be open to the public. However, if the Chairperson of the Mediation Committee deems it necessary, parties to the dispute and other interested parties may be allowed to observe.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 조정의 대상이 된 분쟁의 당사자는 조정위원회에 출석하여 의견을 진술할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Parties to the dispute subject to mediation may attend the mediation committee and state their opinions.

rows.source_ko: 제36조(위원의 수당) 조정위원회에 출석한 위원에 대해서는 예산의 범위에서 수당과 그 밖에 필요한 경비를 지급할 수 있다. 다만, 공무원인 위원이 그 소관 업무와 직접적으로 관련되어 위원회에 출석하는 경우에는 지급하지 않는다.
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Allowances for Members) Members attending the Coordination Committee may be paid allowances and other necessary expenses within the limits of the budget. However, no payment shall be made to a member who is a public official attending the Committee in direct relation to their assigned duties.

rows.source_ko: 제37조(조정위원회의 운영세칙) 제30조부터 제36조까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 조정위원회의 운영에 필요한 사항은 조정위원회의 위원장이 조정위원회의 의결을 거쳐 운영세칙으로 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Detailed Operational Rules of the Mediation Committee) In addition to the matters stipulated in Articles 30 through 36, matters necessary for the operation of the Mediation Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson of the Mediation Committee through the detailed operational rules following a resolution by the Mediation Committee.

rows.source_ko: 제38조(위반행위의 신고 등) ① 법 제29조의2제2항에 따른 신고를 하려는 자는 다음 각 호에 관한 사항을 기재한 서면을 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출해야 한다. 다만, 신고사항이 긴급을 요하거나 부득이한 경우에는 구두 또는 전화 등으로 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 38 (Reporting of Violations, etc.) ① Any person who intends to make a report pursuant to Article 29-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a written document containing matters concerning each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. However, if the matters to be reported require urgency or are unavoidable, the report may be made orally or by telephone, etc.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신고인 또는 피신고인의 회사ㆍ법인명 또는 대표자 성명, 주소, 전화번호
rows.text_en: 1. Name of the company/legal entity or representative, address, and telephone number of the complainant or the respondent

rows.source_ko: 2. 피신고인이 이 법을 위반한 행위의 내용
rows.text_en: 2. Details of the act in which the reported party violated this Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 위반행위의 내용을 입증할 수 있는 자료
rows.text_en: 3. Other materials that can prove the details of the violation

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제29조의3제1항제1호에 따라 이해관계인 또는 참고인의 출석을 요구하여 의견을 듣는 경우에는 그 이해관계인 또는 참고인에게 예산의 범위에서 필요한 경비를 지급할 수 있다. 다만, 이해관계인 또는 참고인의 사무소나 사업장에서 의견을 듣는 경우에는 그렇지 않다.
rows.text_en: ② In cases where the attendance of an interested party or a witness is requested and opinions are heard pursuant to Article 29-3, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 1 of the Act , necessary expenses may be paid to said interested party or witness within the limits of the budget. However, this shall not apply in cases where opinions are heard at the office or workplace of the interested party or witness.

rows.source_ko: 제39조(위반행위의 조사) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제29조의3제1항제1호에 따른 처분을 하려는 경우에는 사건명, 상대방의 성명, 출석일시 및 장소 등의 내용을 기재한 출석요구서를 보내야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 39 (Investigation of Violations) ① When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs intends to take action pursuant to Article 29-3, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall send a summons to appear, stating the name of the case, the name of the opposing party, the date and time of appearance, and the place of appearance.

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제29조의3제1항제2호에 따른 처분은 사건명, 제출일시, 보고 또는 제출자료 등을 구체적으로 기재한 서면으로 하되, 신속한 조사가 필요한 경우에는 구두 또는 전화 등으로 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall make a disposition pursuant to Article 29-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act in writing, specifying the case name, date and time of submission, report or submitted materials, etc., but may do so orally or by telephone, etc., if a prompt investigation is necessary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제29조의3제2항에 따라 조사를 하는 공무원이 계약농가, 계열화사업자 또는 계열화사업자의 임직원에 대하여 조사에 필요한 자료나 물건의 제출을 명하거나 제출된 자료나 물건의 영치를 할 수 있는 경우는 증거인멸의 우려가 있는 경우로 한정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The cases in which a public official conducting an investigation pursuant to Article 29-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act may order a contract farm, an integrated business operator, or an executive or employee of an integrated business operator to submit materials or items necessary for the investigation, or to seize submitted materials or items, are limited to cases where there is a risk of destruction of evidence.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제29조의3제4항에 따른 증표는 별지 제13호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The identification card pursuant to Article 29-3, Paragraph 4 of the Act is as in Form No. 13 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제40조(조사 등의 연기신청) ① 법 제29조의5제1항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 사유”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사유를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Application for Postponement of Investigation, etc.) ① The term “reasons prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” in Article 29-5, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to any of the following reasons:

rows.source_ko: 1. 인수ㆍ합병, 화의 또는 법정관리신청, 파산 및 그 밖에 이에 준하는 절차가 진행되고 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where mergers and acquisitions, composition with creditors, applications for court-supervised reorganization, bankruptcy, or other equivalent proceedings are in progress

rows.source_ko: 2. 권한 있는 기관에 장부ㆍ증거서류가 압수 또는 영치되어 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where books or evidentiary documents have been seized or held by an authorized agency

rows.source_ko: 3. 화재, 자연재해 등으로 인하여 계열화사업자의 계열화사업 운영에 중대한 장애가 발생한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. In the event that a serious impediment occurs to the operation of the affiliated business by the affiliated business operator due to fire, natural disasters, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제29조의5제1항에 따라 처분 또는 조사의 연기를 신청하려는 자는 다음 각 호의 사항을 기재한 서면을 농림축산식품부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to apply for a postponement of a disposition or investigation pursuant to Article 29-5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a written document containing the following items to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 처분 또는 조사의 연기를 신청하는 계열화사업자의 명칭 및 대표자의 성명ㆍ주소ㆍ전화번호
rows.text_en: 1. Name of the affiliated business operator applying for a postponement of disposition or investigation, and the name, address, and telephone number of the representative

rows.source_ko: 2. 처분 또는 조사를 연기하려는 기간
rows.text_en: 2. Period during which the disposition or investigation is to be postponed

rows.source_ko: 3. 처분 또는 조사의 연기를 신청하는 사유 및 이를 증명할 수 있는 자료
rows.text_en: 3. Reasons for requesting a postponement of the disposition or investigation and materials that can prove them

rows.source_ko: 제41조(계열화사업자의 자료 제출) 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제32조제2항에 따라 계열화사업자에게 다음 각 호에 관한 자료를 제출하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 41 (Submission of Data by Affiliated Business Operators) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may require an affiliated business operator to submit data regarding each of the following items pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 계열화사업자가 직접 또는 계약농가에게 공급하여 사육 중인 가축의 사육현황
rows.text_en: 1. Status of livestock being raised by vertically integrated business operators, either directly or supplied to contract farms

rows.source_ko: 2. 가축(축산물을 포함한다)의 구입 및 판매
rows.text_en: 2. Purchase and sale of livestock (including livestock products)

rows.source_ko: 3. 가축의 사육과 관련하여 계약농가와 체결한 계약서 및 그 이행 현황
rows.text_en: 3. Contracts concluded with contract farms regarding livestock rearing and status of their implementation

rows.source_ko: 4. 계약농가에 대한 농가지급금 지급명세
rows.text_en: 4. Details of Farm Payments to Contract Farms

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제9조제1항에 따른 계열화사업자의 준수사항 이행 여부
rows.text_en: 5. Whether the affiliated business operator has complied with the requirements pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 농림축산식품부장관이 계열화사업의 정책 수립과 합리적 운영을 위하여 정하는 자료
rows.text_en: 6. Other data determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the formulation of policies and rational operation of vertical integration businesses

rows.source_ko: 제42조(검사공무원의 증표) 법 제32조제3항에 따른 검사공무원의 증표는 별지 제13호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 42 (Identification Card of Inspection Officials) The identification card of an inspection official pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in the form of Annex 13 .

rows.source_ko: 제43조(판매가격의 보고ㆍ공개) ① 계열화사업자는 법 제32조의2제1항에 따라 농림축산식품부장관에게 다음 각 호의 가축에 대한 축산물 판매가격을 보고해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 43 (Reporting and Disclosure of Sales Prices) ① An integrated business operator shall report the sales prices of livestock products for the livestock listed in each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs pursuant to Article 32-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 닭(육계, 토종닭, 삼계만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Chicken (only applies to broiler chickens, native chickens, and Samgye chickens)

rows.source_ko: 2. 오리(육용오리만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Duck (only meat ducks)

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제32조의2제1항에 따른 보고 대상 축산물의 종류, 보고의 내용ㆍ방법 및 기한은 별표 6에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The types of livestock products subject to reporting under Article 32-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , and the contents, methods, and deadlines of reporting shall be in accordance with Annex 6 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 판매가격의 보고는 별지 제14호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The reporting of sales prices pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 농림축산식품부장관은 제1항에 따라 보고받은 축산물 판매가격을 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 공개한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall disclose the sales prices of livestock products reported pursuant to Paragraph 1 in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. The daily, weekly, and monthly average selling price of all vertically integrated business operators (referring to the selling price by type of livestock product, without discounts or surcharges, by applying transaction conditions under a separate contract. The same applies hereinafter in this paragraph)
rows.text_en: 1. The daily, weekly, and monthly average selling price of all vertically integrated business operators (referring to the selling price by type of livestock product, without discounts or surcharges, by applying transaction conditions under a separate contract. The same applies hereinafter in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. Daily, weekly, and monthly average sales prices by affiliated business operator and sales target (in this case, company or legal entity names are not displayed so that the affiliated business operator's company or legal entity cannot be identified)
rows.text_en: 2. Daily, weekly, and monthly average sales prices by affiliated business operator and sales target (in this case, company or legal entity names are not displayed so that the affiliated business operator's company or legal entity cannot be identified)

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The types of livestock products and the contents and timing of disclosure for each category of livestock product sales price disclosure pursuant to Paragraph 4 are as set forth in Table 7 .
rows.text_en: ⑤ The types of livestock products and the contents and timing of disclosure for each category of livestock product sales price disclosure pursuant to Paragraph 4 are as set forth in Table 7 .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall, pursuant to Article 32-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , entrust the duties concerning the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices under Paragraphs 1 and 4 to the Livestock Product Quality Evaluation Institute pursuant to Article 36 of the Livestock Act .
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall, pursuant to Article 32-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , entrust the duties concerning the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices under Paragraphs 1 and 4 to the Livestock Product Quality Evaluation Institute pursuant to Article 36 of the Livestock Act .

rows.source_ko: ⑦ The Livestock Product Quality Evaluation Agency shall report to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs by the 20th of the following month the status of processing for the previous month regarding the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices entrusted to it pursuant to Paragraph 6.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Livestock Product Quality Evaluation Agency shall report to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs by the 20th of the following month the status of processing for the previous month regarding the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices entrusted to it pursuant to Paragraph 6.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 7, matters necessary for the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
rows.text_en: ⑧ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 7, matters necessary for the reporting and disclosure of livestock product sales prices shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
